projects.title: PurePee
projects.subtitle: Smart Urine Screening at the Point-of-Care (POC)
projects.title_th: PurePee – ระบบคัดกรองปัสสาวะอัจฉริยะ ณ จุดบริการ

competition.name: Medical Innovation Idea Challenge (MIIC)
competition.level: Secondary school (ระดับมัธยมศึกษา)

projects.advisor: Weeraphol Lapkerd (วีรพล ลาภเกิด)
projects.problem: 589 million people live with diabetes worldwide and 43% (252 million) are undiagnosed. People in remote areas lack nearby equipment and medical staff, face travel costs and lost income, and usually only get checked once symptoms appear.
projects.solution: A point-of-care device that reads urine test strips automatically with an RGB sensor and camera, analyzes the colors with AI against a color reference patch, and sends results to a mobile/web app over Bluetooth.
workflow: Collect urine into the test strip's sample port
Hybrid reading: RGB sensor scan + camera capture
AI analysis and cross-check against medical standards
Generate health result and send to the app
details: PurePee is a low-cost point-of-care device that reads urine test strips automatically with an RGB sensor, a camera and AI. It helps people in remote areas screen early for diabetes and kidney disease.
highlights: Automated reading removes human error from visual strip inspection
Non-contact operation reduces biohazard exposure for health workers
Cost per test about 0.30–0.75 USD vs 13.4–44.68 USD for a lab test
Screening data can support national health planning (SDG 3)

projects.subtitle: AI-powered app to prevent phone scams targeting tourists

competition.name: Thailand New Gen Inventors Award (I-New Gen Award) 2026
competition.organizer: National Research Council of Thailand (NRCT / วช.)
competition.group: Tourism and Creative Economy (กลุ่มการท่องเที่ยวและเศรษฐกิจสร้างสรรค์)

team: Prant Lekprayura (ปรานต์ เล็กประยูร)
projects.advisor: Weeraphol Lapkerd (วีรพล ลาภเกิด)
projects.problem: Thailand welcomed 26.7 million foreign tourists in the first 10 months of 2025, but phone scams and fake accommodation bookings are eroding tourists' trust and Thailand's image.
projects.solution: A web app (Scam Checker) and AI voice app (Cally) that let tourists check phone numbers, messages and accommodations before they transact. Tourists simply scan a QR code at airports or hotels to open it — no install needed.
workflow: Tourist scans a QR code at an airport or hotel to open the web app
Choose a feature: phone number check, scammer database, or Hotel Scraper
System assesses risk and shows Safe / Risky / In database
Hotel Scraper compares real contact info (phone, Facebook) of verified hotels
app_features: Cally: AI voice and text analysis to detect scam patterns
Real-time suspicious number checking with ML
Hotel Scraper: pulls verified hotel contact details
Central scammer database (phone numbers / bank accounts)
Admin log and user scam reports to improve the database
highlights: No app install — accessible via QR code
ML models: Logistic Regression, Random Forest and SVM
Free public service aimed at boosting tourist confidence
Business model as a social enterprise / public service
